_doc: LR-165: the 48x64 people of the mythic world (pilot sheet v5), drawn by tools/game_2d/web/figures.js and native/figure2d.cpp (pixel-equal; check: node tools/game_2d/figure_sheet.js out.png --check). Figure space: x 0..48 with the middle at mirror_x 24, the ground at y 66, the neck at 22; a people stretches the body below the neck by t {sx, sy} (the head only in width, (sx+1)/2). canvas: the picture (square) and where figure space sits in it (ox, oy), anchor = the feet. Drawing goes by `order` (a layer name, dy: a shift) and in each layer through: base, the people's layers, the outfit's layers, the hair style, the beard, the tool. An op = {s: shape, c: colour, m: "soft flat rim1", pat: [{if: expr over x y, c}], when: expr, sides: "S E N"} | {dot: [x, y, w, h], c} | {ops: name, with: {var: expr}, cwith: {colour: colour}}. A shape = {ell: [cx, cy, rx, ry]} | {cap: [x0, y0, x1, y1, r0, r1]} | {poly: [[x, y]...]} | {rect: [x0, y0, x1, y1]} | {torso: [hem y, flare]} (the torso profile, mirrored) | {or | and: [shapes]} | {sub: [a, b]} | {mir: s} | {both: s} | "@name" | {use: name, with: {var: expr}} | {where: expr}. Numbers are expressions over the variables: v (the variant), fem cen child adult hide kit dressed covered helm bare haschest modest, S E N (the side), step bob swing dip blink (the pose), the people's and the outfit's flags, numbers and vars below; with + - * / % < <= > >= == != && || ! abs min max trunc floor sel(c,a,b). Colours: "#hex", a name (skin hair iris fur coat coat_d chest c c2 ..., colours, the people's and the outfit's colours: a list is picked by v), "a*k" (k<1 darker, >1 toward white), mix(a,b,k), tint(a,r,g,b). The people of a person: races[race] or peoples[race], else cultures_people[culture]; the outfit: cultures[culture][slot] (slot by what the sim says is worn: outfit_by_worn), no torso thing: bare (the hide-nudity option and every child: a plain shift instead). Only adults have a chest: children are drawn without any of it.
